technical.summary: Bullish technical setup with golden cross and three white soldiers, but overbought oscillators, weak ADX trend confirmation, and low volume limit swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: GPC shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 62 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (10/10) with bearish AAII sentiment (53.5%) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absent congressional buying conviction and stale trade data (461+ days old) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds with VIX in crisis territory (372.16), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, and earnings event 62 days out create hostile trading environment for discretionary equities.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross + three white soldiers with extreme fear sentiment (10/10) and contrarian buy signal create textbook reversal setup at potential capitulation moment.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (StochRSI, Williams %R), weak ADX trend confirmation, sub-average volume (0.77), VIX crisis (372.16), macro headwinds, and zero fundamental catalysts make this a bear trap disguised as a reversal.
